# Aviva Will on Fordham Law's "Bite-Sized Business" Podcast


November 5, 2024


-
-
-
-


Burford President[Aviva Will](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/aviva-will/) appears on the "Bite-Sized Business Law" podcast, produced by Fordham Law School, where she "reflects on her role as President, balancing strategic leadership with the responsibilities of an industry-leading company."
